title: 第一卷 第20章 新的目标已经出现！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
帝子殿，主殿。

    林清雅身穿一袭青色素雅的衣裙，正盘坐在床上修炼。

    昨夜姜无痕和沐云溪大婚，整个帝子殿热闹非凡。

    可这份热闹，却像是与她无关。

    习惯了每天被姜无痕缠着，昨夜独守空房，感觉心里有些空落落的。

    她想的太过入迷，就连姜无痕回来都没察觉到。

    直到那温暖熟悉的臂膀，将她抱在怀中，林清雅这才回过神来。

    她仰起小脸，明显有些意外：“夫君，你怎么来了？”

    “怎么，我不能来吗？”

    姜无痕笑问道。

    林清雅连忙摇头，解释道：“当然不是，夫君想什么时候来都可以。只是，昨夜刚与新人大婚，今天不多陪陪新人，反倒来我这边，人家该以为是我不懂事，霸占着你了！”

    “你真这么想？”

    姜无痕饶有兴致的道。

    林清雅低下头，有些不好意思的道：“其实，也有些舍不得夫君。不过，我现在有了身孕，无法更好的侍奉夫君，不能耽误夫君为家族开枝散叶的大计。夫君只管去就好，我不会多想的！”

    “夫人这么通情达理，我反倒是更想补偿夫人了！”

    姜无痕凑近，在她耳畔轻声道。

    林清雅俏脸微红，眼角余光看向门外，小声呢喃道：“帝子殿现在人多起来了，先关门吧……”

    “夫人，我说的不是这种补偿。”

    姜无痕无奈笑道。

    林清雅顿时羞红了脸，恨不得把脸埋进胸口，小声嘀咕道：“夫君，你一定是故意的，就想看我难为情的样子……”

    “夫人，你这可就冤枉好人了，我是真的想补偿你的！”

    姜无痕一脸无辜道。

    “那，怎么补偿？”

    林清雅一脸天真的道。

    姜无痕上下打量着她，坏笑道：“今晚我们三个一起，这样既不会亏待云溪，又能陪着夫人你！”

    一瞬间，林清雅小嘴微张，像是听到了什么不得了的事情，小脸以肉眼可见的速度变得红润。

    “不可以！”

    林清雅连忙摇头，又羞又气道：“夫君，这样不行的，我暂时还接受不了……”

    “也就是说，以后有机会了？”

    姜无痕饶有兴致的道。

    林清雅没有再接话，脸红的像是熟透的苹果。

    姜无痕见她这幅娇艳欲滴的模样，也是来了兴致。

    “那还是，按夫人所说的方式……进行补偿吧！”

    为了照顾她的身体，这次匆匆结束，前后不到半个时辰。

    随即，在林清雅的催促下，姜无痕穿好衣服去了偏殿。

    与此同时，偏殿内。

    沐云溪已经穿戴齐整，恢复了平日的典雅端庄。

    初为人妻的她，比昨日更显温婉知性，也更加妩媚动人。
content_en:
The Emperor's Palace, the main hall.

    Lin Qingya was wearing an elegant blue dress and was sitting cross-legged on the bed practicing.

    Last night Jiang Wuhen and Mu Yunxi got married, and the entire Emperor's Palace was bustling with excitement.

    But this excitement seemed to have nothing to do with her.

    I was used to being pestered by Jiang Wuhen every day, and I felt a little empty in my heart when I stayed alone in the empty room last night.

    She was so obsessed with her thoughts that she didn't even notice Jiang Wuhen's return.

    It wasn't until those warm and familiar arms held her in his arms that Lin Qingya came back to her senses.

    She raised her little face, obviously a little surprised: "Husband, why are you here?"

    "What, can't I come?"

    Jiang Wuhen asked with a smile.

    Lin Qingya shook her head quickly and explained: "Of course not. My husband can come anytime he wants. However, I just got married to the new couple last night. I don't spend much time with the new couple today. Instead, you come to my place. People should think that I am ignorant and occupying you!"

    "You really think so?"

    Jiang Wuhen said with great interest.

    Lin Qingya lowered her head and said with some embarrassment: "Actually, I am a little bit reluctant to leave my husband. However, I am pregnant now, so I cannot serve my husband better, and I cannot delay my husband's plan to expand the family. Just go and I won't think too much about it!"

    "Madam is so reasonable, but I want to compensate her even more!"

    Jiang Wuhen came closer and whispered in her ear.

    Lin Qingya's pretty face was slightly red. She looked out of the corner of her eyes and murmured in a low voice: "There are more people in the Emperor's Palace now. Let's close the door first..."

    "Ma'am, I'm not talking about this kind of compensation."

    Jiang Wuhen smiled helplessly.

    Lin Qingya suddenly blushed with embarrassment and wished she could bury her face in her chest. She whispered: "Husband, you must have done it on purpose. You just want to see me embarrassed..."

    "Madam, you have wronged a good person. I really want to make it up to you!"

    Jiang Wuhen said with an innocent look.

    "Then, how to compensate?"

    Lin Qingya said innocently.

    Jiang Wuhen looked her up and down and said with a wicked smile: "The three of us will be together tonight. This way we won't treat Yun Xi badly and we can accompany you, madam!"

    For a moment, Lin Qingya's mouth opened slightly, as if she had heard something terrible, and her face turned rosy at a speed visible to the naked eye.

    "No!"

    Lin Qingya shook her head quickly and said with shame and anger: "Husband, this is not going to work. I can't accept it for the time being..."

    "In other words, will there be a chance in the future?"

    Jiang Wuhen said with great interest.

    Lin Qingya didn't answer any more, her face was as red as a ripe apple.

    Jiang Wuhen also became interested when he saw her charming appearance.

    "Then let's make compensation according to the way Madam said..."

    In order to take care of her body, this time it ended in a hurry, less than half an hour.

    Immediately, at Lin Qingya's urging, Jiang Wuhen got dressed and went to the side hall.

    At the same time, in the side hall.

    Mu Yunxi was fully dressed and returned to her usual elegance and dignity.

    As a wife for the first time, she looked more gentle, intellectual, and charming than yesterday.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 20 A new target has appeared!
